description: This file contains a PHP trait called S3ClientTrait, which provides S3-specific functionalities for interacting with Amazon S3 via the AWS SDK for PHP. The trait includes methods for uploading, copying, deleting objects, and managing buckets, designed to be used within classes implementing the S3ClientInterface.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: A synchronous method that uploads an object to an S3 bucket by internally calling the asynchronous uploadAsync method and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: An asynchronous method that initiates the upload of an object to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: A synchronous method that copies an object within S3, utilizing the copyAsync method and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: An asynchronous method that initiates copying an object within S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the current S3 client as a stream wrapper for direct s3:// access.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers the S3 client as a stream wrapper with additional options.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects matching a prefix or regex pattern synchronously.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous deletion of matching objects, returning a promise.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Uploads a directory to S3 synchronously via the uploadDirectoryAsync method.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Uploads a directory to S3 asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads a bucket's contents to a local directory synchronously.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Downloads a bucket asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Synchronously determines the AWS region of a specified bucket.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the AWS region of a specified bucket, returning a promise.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists synchronously.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists synchronously with more options for error handling.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in a bucket synchronously.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in a bucket with additional options.

methods.name: checkExistenceWithCommand
methods.description: Helper method to determine existence of a resource via a command, handling exceptions.
